deadline.value: Doctoral sign-up for Fall Semester 2027 closes 31 July 2027 under the university's doctoral deadline table, which applies to every doctoral subject.
deadline.quote: Doctoral Studies Semester Fall Semester 2027 Sign up until 31 Jul 2027

gre_subject.value: No Physics GRE subject test is mentioned.

supervisor.value: You apply directly to the professor leading the group you want to join; PI approval lets you skip further entrance examinations.
supervisor.quote: Apply directly to the professor heading the group (PI) your are interested and qualified to work in

also.quote: Applicants who are eligible for the Physics doctoral degree program, whom the PI of the respective research group has approved, do not have to undergo any further examinations

funding.value: Doctoral students are in general employed as teaching assistants, on a salary meant to cover living and studying costs in Basel.
funding.quote: In general all doctoral students at our Department will be employed, usually as a teaching assistant, with a salary sufficient to cover the cost of living and studying in Basel

entry_route.value: Applicants need a master's degree (usually in physics) or an equivalent; a bachelor's degree alone is considered insufficient.
entry_route.quote: the University of Basel requires a master’s degree (usually, but not necessarily, in Physics) or a degree considered equivalent to a master’s degree | A bachelor’s degree in general is considered insufficient for an admission into the doctoral degree program

notes: Department page says English is the main language and German is not required for PhD research; that is not an English test, so the university English values apply. The page links an FS19 faculty PDF, which is too old and was not used. The university deadline table applies to all doctoral subjects, so the physics deadline is taken from it.
